packageRules.description: Development dependencies: the dev groups of the Python projects, the web UI's devDependencies; its own branch prefix keeps every branch to one label (a package in files of two labels gets two pull requests)
The devcontainer: its features and the services of its compose file; its own branch prefix keeps every branch to one label (a package in files of two labels gets two pull requests)
The actions of the workflows, pinned to their commits; its own branch prefix keeps every branch to one label (a package in files of two labels gets two pull requests)
Lekto's own images, which the compose examples name
Claude Code of the dev container; its own branch prefix keeps every branch to one label (a package in files of two labels gets two pull requests)
Collective PR: every non-major update of the runtime dependencies (backend, migration client, web UI, images); majors come one by one
Collective PR: every non-major update of the development dependencies, like their label
Collective PR: the devcontainer goes with the development dependencies
Collective PR: Claude Code of the dev container goes with the development dependencies

bits-ui in a pull request of its own: its updates change the behaviour of dialogs, menus and tooltips (2.20 closes them a frame later) and need a look of their own, which would hold up the development dependencies
GreenMail 2.1.15 refuses a LOGIN whose password is a UTF-8 literal beyond ASCII (the contract test test_a_password_beyond_ascii fails); skip that version
Collective PR: every non-major update of the actions
